scope: UI, browser geometry, catalogs, local scenario service, Reports and representative tests

findings.claim: Selected-race analysis detail is fetched by App after replay selection, including while Replay is open; Analysis also has a panel-specific cache.
UI historical metric display uses Python exports; per-leg scope selects exported evidence rather than recomputing indexes.
Exact scenario input, same-origin localhost service, 750 ms polling, workspace lock with publisher child ownership and immutable path validation are implemented.
Some camera tests inspect source strings or restate wiring; executable service tests, real byte hash tests and browser interaction checks provide stronger complementary evidence.
